description: Makes a rib from an open sketch on a part that has a body: the sketch's lines are thickened into a wall that runs out until it meets the body. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. Checked: the feature exists as a rib, rebuilds without error, the part's volume grew, and it made faces. Otherwise the rib is deleted and the part is as it was (rolled back); the sketch stays. Busy with user_editing while the user is editing a sketch or has a command open. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The part: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

sketch.description: The rib's sketch: its name or reference. Usually one open line or chain, drawn on a plane through the body, its ends short of the body's walls.

thickness_mm.description: The rib's thickness, mm, more than 0.

side.description: both (the default: half the thickness each side of the sketch), one_side or other_side.

normal_to_sketch.description: Run the rib out normal to the sketch's plane instead of in it (parallel to the sketch, the default).

flip_material.description: Run the material the other way from the sketch, when SOLIDWORKS' choice of side does not reach the body. Default false.

draft_deg.description: A draft angle, degrees, more than 0 and less than 90; no draft when absent.

draft_outward.description: The draft widens the rib as it goes instead of narrowing it. Default false. Only with draft_deg.
